title: DATA↔PO-001: Data Readiness for Release + Cost/Retention Reporting
description: The Data Engineer provides data-readiness status, data pipeline status, data quality / availability blockers affecting ML or feature readiness, and cost/retention reporting; the Product Owner/TPM provides data requirements (driven by ML/feature needs and field-data availability constraints), the retention/compliance policy, and prioritization. Grounded in DATA_ENGINEER_SKILL §6.8 and PRODUCT_OWNER_TECHNICAL_PROJECT_MANAGER_SKILL §6.6. Data-quality severities are governed by the DQIR (Data Quality Incident Report, ML→DATA); a CRITICAL/HIGH DQIR blocks the MLOps training pipeline and must not be reported as release-ready.

data_status_report.description: DATA→PO: data readiness, pipeline status, quality/availability blockers, cost/retention reporting.

dqir_ref.description: DQIR reference when the blocker is a logged data-quality incident.

po_data_inputs.description: PO→DATA: data requirements, retention/compliance policy, prioritization.

x-macp.tier_rationale: Routine data-readiness and cost/retention reporting is agent-autonomous (requirement intake; milestone reviews; cost/retention review). A data-availability blocker on an ML milestone forces immediate escalation; a CRITICAL/HIGH DQIR is governed by the DQIR gate (blocks the training pipeline), not resolved here.
x-macp.cadence: TRIGGER (requirement intake; milestone reviews; cost/retention review; sprint-level sync; immediate escalation if data availability blocks an ML milestone)
confirm_conditions: cost figures carry value, currency, and unit; retention period carries an explicit unit
every quality blocker carries a severity; a logged data-quality incident carries its DQIR reference
an availability blocker on an ML milestone is described and flagged for immediate escalation
reject_conditions: data_readiness = READY asserted while an open CRITICAL/HIGH quality blocker (or unresolved CRITICAL/HIGH DQIR) exists (Honesty Over Polish §10.3; DQIR blocks the pipeline)
a cost or retention quantity emitted without a unit (units rule §3.10)
retention_reporting.compliance_status = NON_COMPLIANT reported as release-ready without a remediation plan
counter_conditions: a data requirement is untestable / lacks an availability constraint — request a measurable definition before committing readiness
a quality blocker lacks a DQIR yet meets CRITICAL/HIGH severity — request DQIR filing before the readiness call (DQIR owns the correction SLA)
